_about: PARKED DRAFT (docs/narrative/pending/). Provenance of the 30 lines of homework 11 (the brawl, blow by blow). Orb ran the homework through Google's Gemini and kept 4 lines and took 26 rewrites, recorded here as Gemini's at Orb's direction, under Orb's disclosure rule (docs/ep/vision.md, 'AI disclosure'). Every line in the game, human or AI, should carry a `source` of this kind in its data; the field is proposed, not yet in a schema.

lines.situation: He lands the first blow of the match.
lines.original_text: First hit's mine! Show me what you've got!
lines.text: First hit's mine! Show me what you've got!

lines.situation: He takes a heavy hit in the ribs and skids back.
lines.original_text: Ow! Where'd you learn that one?
lines.text: Ooh, felt that in my back teeth! Nice shot!

lines.situation: The rival slips under his swing.
lines.original_text: Wait, how'd you get under that?
lines.text: Clean slip! You read my shoulder, didn't you?

lines.situation: He catches a heavy blow on his guard at the last instant.
lines.original_text: Whoa, that one had real weight behind it!
lines.text: Whoa, that one had real weight behind it!

lines.situation: He hits the rival so hard they fly down the street.
lines.original_text: Get up! Tell me that was nothing!
lines.text: Don't tell me that's enough to keep you down!

lines.situation: The rival goes through the wall of a shop.
lines.original_text: Sorry, shop! I'll pay for that later!
lines.text: Oof, bad landing! Shake it off, I'm coming in!
lines.flag: Orb's rule: no lines to objects; the rewrite also retires the apology.

lines.situation: He is knocked into a tower and left stuck in its wall.
lines.original_text: Okay, I'm stuck. Give me a second!
lines.text: Hang on, the bricks got me! ...Alright, I'm loose!
lines.flag: Contains an ellipsis (the lint cap for the Protagonist block is one line in ten).

lines.situation: He is caught in a long flurry and cannot answer.
lines.original_text: Keep going! I'm learning your rhythm!
lines.text: Faster! I'm just starting to see your timing!

lines.situation: He lands a heavy blow that sends the Protagonist back.
lines.original_text: Still grinning? Get up and try again.
lines.text: Still grinning? Get up and try again.

lines.situation: He is struck in the face and his glasses slip.
lines.original_text: Touch the glasses again and you're done.
lines.text: You grazed my frames. You won't get that close twice.

lines.situation: His blow hits only air.
lines.original_text: Stand still! I'm not chasing you all day.
lines.text: Quit hopping around like a flea and trade with me!

lines.situation: He takes a heavy blow on his plate without moving his feet.
lines.original_text: That's it? I barely felt that.
lines.text: That's your heavy hitter? Strictly third-rate.

lines.situation: He launches the Protagonist toward a skyscraper.
lines.original_text: Get up from that one. I dare you.
lines.text: Stay buried in the rubble where you belong!

lines.situation: He is slammed through a wall.
lines.original_text: Cheap shot. Don't expect another one.
lines.text: Lucky swing! Don't act like you earned that!

lines.situation: He is wedged in a window frame, upside down.
lines.original_text: Don't laugh. I'm getting out.
lines.text: Wipe that smirk off your face or you die first!
lines.flag: Legal c08: threat of death spoken by the rival. Legal reads it.

lines.situation: The Protagonist's flurry pushes him back across the street.
lines.original_text: You're holding back, aren't you? Hit harder!
lines.text: You're holding back, aren't you? Hit harder!

lines.situation: She lands a blow with her bladed mantle.
lines.original_text: Guard, write that down. We were magnificent.
lines.text: Hahaha! Look at you bleed—what a gorgeous mess!
lines.flag: Legal: 'Look at you bleed' (EP flag c).

lines.situation: She is struck and her mantle is knocked askew.
lines.original_text: Watch the mantle! It's brand new!
lines.text: Oh, you dirtied the silk? That'll cost you a limb.

lines.situation: Her beam misses; the target has moved.
lines.original_text: Hold still, petitioner! That's an order!
lines.text: Dance, little rat! We'll just glass the whole street!
lines.flag: R3: 'dance' is on Orb's own banned list, so this line fails the lint. 'Glass the whole street' is on Legal's list (EP flag c). Alternate if Orb wants the lint kept: 'Scatter, little rat! We'll glass the whole street!'

lines.situation: She catches a heavy blow on her mantle.
lines.original_text: Our mantle's not for hitting, petitioner!
lines.text: All that grunting just to wrinkle our cape? Tragic!

lines.situation: She launches the Protagonist across a field.
lines.original_text: Come back when you're presentable, petitioner!
lines.text: Petition denied! Crawl back if your legs still work!

lines.situation: She is thrown through a wall.
lines.original_text: We did not approve that wall!
lines.text: Gahaha! Good hit! Now watch how an Empress breaks things!

lines.situation: She is wedged in a chimney.
lines.original_text: Guard! Get us out of here. Now!
lines.text: Nobody sees the Empress like this! Level this whole block!
lines.flag: Legal: 'Level this whole block' reads as a threat to a block of people; Legal reads it.

lines.situation: He lands a heavy clamp.
lines.original_text: Compliments of the chef, sir!
lines.text: Gotcha! My sensors say you're packed with protein!
lines.flag: Legal: the Cyborg eating fighters ('protein'; EP flag c).

lines.situation: He is struck on the arm.
lines.original_text: That'll come out of your tip, sir.
lines.text: Hey, that's the steel arm! Bite the meaty one!

lines.situation: A blow grazes the chip on his head.
lines.original_text: N-not the chip, sir! Please!
lines.text: Watch the chip! Break my limiter and I'll eat the arena!

lines.situation: His grab closes on empty air.
lines.original_text: Sir, you left your seat. Come back!
lines.text: Quit dodging! I'm burning more calories than you're worth!

lines.situation: He blocks a heavy blow with his forearm.
lines.original_text: Sorry, sir. Not on the menu.
lines.text: Titanium plating, snack! Though your knuckles look real crunchy...
lines.flag: Contains an ellipsis (the lint cap for the Cyborg block is one line in ten).

lines.situation: He launches an opponent through a window.
lines.original_text: Window seat, sir! Just like you asked!
lines.text: Gotta tenderize the tough ones! Don't crawl too far, lunch!
lines.flag: Legal: the Cyborg eating fighters ('lunch', 'tenderize'; EP flag c).

lines.situation: He is wedged in a doorway.
lines.original_text: I'll be right with you. I'm stuck.
lines.text: Stupid wide chassis! Knew I shouldn't have eaten that tank!
